m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Jambo, young Wizard. What brings you back to Zafaria? You are searching for the Kasbah of Zanj?
I have a scroll that will unlock the Kasbah of Zanj, but the rest is up to you.
You will find that cursed tower in Stone Town. A snakebit lioness, Zola Witch Eye, prowls there.
All this spellcraft makes me hungry. Here, have a Jelly Baby!
High drama, inflamed passions, and everyday nonsense rolled into one! Our missions are similar, dear Wizard!
Did Zola Witch Eye give you any trouble? No? Excellent. Did you enlist Mokompo Storm Growler to your cause?
Fantastic! Let me show you the spell to summon him whenever you need.
Head to Zafaria and find Kiliman Copperleaf in the Baobab Library. Ask him where to find the Kasbah of Zanj.
I mixed it up with the Kasbah's guardian once - barely got out with my skin. I think.
Defeat the Kasbah's guardians so you can perform the summoning ritual using the Globe of Peladon!
Best of luck, eh. Let me know how it goes!
Find Kiliman Copperleaf in Zafaria and ask him to tell you how to find the Kasbah of Zanj.
Defeat the Kasbah's guardians so you can use the Globe of Peladon!
